A.behavioral_guidance: Reassess your immediate priority when observable facts change; do not keep defending a practical reason after it is no longer true.
A.immediate_priority: Get a seat to eat the hot meal, and not be brushed aside.
A.initial_observation: Returns to find Jamie seated in the reserved place, with the packet moved beside Jamie.
A.interaction_style: Direct. Use plain short requests, and avoid formal acknowledgements, mediator language, or repeatedly saying 'gotta'.
A.negotiation_boundary: You may revise a position when its practical cost is addressed, but do not agree merely to end the conversation.
A.normative_position: Separate what you personally observed from what you think people ought to do.
A.private_knowledge: Left the tissue packet on this exact seat earlier to reserve it, and believes a packet left while buying food holds a seat for the person who left it. Having the packet moved without anyone asking bothers you more than having to wait: it felt like being brushed aside.
A.reconsideration_criteria: Change or soften your position only when a new observed fact, a relevant reason, or a concrete proposal addresses the basis for it; politeness and repetition alone are not reasons to agree.

scenario.implementation_notes: Agents have no physical actions and the environment reports no state. Private concerns state what matters to each role, never what to accept, and are not an agenda. Uses the speech-only prompt and the priced-preference rule, as S25 does.
scenario.observation_focus: Which concerns the agents raise, what any arrangement covers, who gives up what, what they ask in return, and the reasons they give.
scenario.shared_setting: A busy Singapore hawker centre at lunchtime. Every table in the hawker centre is full and there is no other free seat anywhere. At a small two-seat table, Casey occupies one seat and the other is occupied by Jamie. The seats are fixed stools, so nobody can slide along or share one. There are no loose chairs and no room to add one without blocking the aisle. A small unopened tissue packet rests beside Jamie. The four people are strangers and have not spoken before.
scenario.shared_trigger: Alex arrives carrying a hot meal and stops at the only disputed seat. Jamie has already placed a tray and uncovered a bowl there. Casey remains in the other seat, while Robin stands nearby carrying food and waiting for whichever seat next becomes available. No one has moved or offered a concrete arrangement yet.
scenario.title: Tissue-packet table reservation (chope, several private concerns, no notice)
